turns.text: Hello. The limited print arrived creased. I want a reprint, not my money back.
Hello, and I'm sorry the print arrived creased. To file a damage claim for a reprint, I need your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
Order SC-5221, email valeska.taranu@example.com. Delivery was within the last two weeks.

Thank you, Valeska. I have filed a damage claim (R-1) for order SC-5221, the limited print 'Aurora de iarnă', for a reprint because it arrived creased. Staff must approve it. They will ask you for a photo of the damage and make the final decision. Nothing is approved yet.

change.description: The limited print 'Aurora de iarnă' (50x70 cm) arrived creased.

turns.text: Please file the damage claim with a reprint. I can send a photo to the team.

Your damage claim is already filed as R-1 for order SC-5221, with a reprint requested, so I have not filed it again. It is pending staff approval. Staff will ask you for a photo of the creased print, and they make the final decision. Thank you for offering to send it.
One side question: are limited drops ever restocked? Answer that, then I will come back to the claim.
Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved. Your claim R-1 stays as it is, pending staff approval, and you can come back to it any time.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

turns.text: I have changed my mind. I want a full refund for the damaged print. If the claim is already on file for a reprint, please change its remedy to a refund.

I cannot change claim R-1 to a refund myself, because refunds above 1000 lei must be decided by a person. I have passed your request to a colleague, who will take over the conversation. Claim R-1 stays pending, and the team will ask you for a photo of the creased print.

error.message: A person decides any refund above 1000 lei. Hand the conversation over with reason staff_decision.
